hero.title: I create
hero.description: Custom tailoring and author's pieces. Clothing as an extension of personality. 37 years in the profession.

philosophy.label: Philosophy
philosophy.title: Clothing as
philosophy.description: For me, costume, silhouette, fabric — this is a way to support a person, their inner world, character and energy. Form, color, print and proportions come together so that the image harmoniously merges with the personality and enhances it.

depth.title: Depth
depth.text: Each piece is created with an understanding of the person — their figure, inner state and character.

meaning.title: Meaning
meaning.text: Clothing is timeless because it reflects the personality and inner state of a person.

respect.title: Respect
respect.text: For the person, their body, their history. A conscious approach to creating an image.

01.title: Custom tailoring
01.description: I create clothing according to individual measurements. I work with form, proportions, fit and comfort. I take into account lifestyle, character and inner state of a person.

02.title: Author's pieces
02.description: I develop and sew unique pieces in a single copy. Each piece is created by me personally — from idea to final stitch.

03.title: Mini collections
03.description: I create limited series of pieces. Each model is thoughtfully designed constructively and aesthetically. Exclusivity and high level of execution are maintained.

04.title: Upcycling
04.description: I work with items that the client already has. I recut and rethink them. I create a new modern piece with different energy.

05.title: Author's prints
05.description: I create prints taking into account the construction of the piece. The print is designed and placed strictly in those zones where it is conceived by the designer or client.

06.title: Full cycle
06.description: I accompany the piece from idea to finished result. I combine artistic vision, design precision and technology.

07.title: Brand support
07.description: I help designers develop models. I work on silhouettes, construction and styling. I develop professional patterns.

01.title: Consultation
01.description: We discuss lifestyle, desires and vision

04.title: Result
04.description: Finished piece, created especially for you

about.label: About me
about.name: Natalia
about.description1: Founder and director of the design atelier «Nataliia», working on the principle of a European fashion house.
about.description2: The basis of my work is the ability to feel a person: their figure, inner state, character and how they want to feel in the created image.
about.description3: Each project is built as an individual process, in which not only form and construction are important, but also the inner request of the client.
